module: Lua layer of the LuaSocket MIME module (Diego Nehab, RFC 2045-2049): base64 and quoted-printable encoding and decoding, line wrapping, line-ending normalization, dot-stuffing (SMTP). Builds LTN12 filters on top of the native functions of the 'mime.core' module (b64, unb64, qp, unqp, wrp, qpwrp, eol, dot).
usage:
local mime = require('mime')
local b64 = mime.b64('texte')           -- native (mime.core)
local f = mime.encode('base64')         -- ltn12 filter
local out = f('texte') .. (f(nil) or '')
notes: The module does require('mime.core') (native part) and require('ltn12') (bare name): the file depends on them. The returned table is that of mime.core, extended by this file, so it also contains the native functions (b64, unb64, qp, unqp...).

encode, decode and wrap accept either an algorithm name or directly their options: if the first argument is not a string, the name 'default' is used. An unknown name raises the error 'unknown key (...)'.
Algorithms: encodet = base64, quoted-printable; decodet = base64, quoted-printable; wrapt = text, base64, default (length 76 by default), quoted-printable.

encodet.desc: Encoding filter factories ('base64', 'quoted-printable'; in 'binary' mode qp uses =0D=0A).

encode.desc: encode(name, opt1, opt2) -> ltn12 encoding filter chosen from encodet.

decode.desc: decode(name, opt1, opt2) -> ltn12 decoding filter chosen from decodet.

wrap.desc: wrap(name, length) -> ltn12 line-wrapping filter chosen from wrapt.

normalize.desc: Creates a filter that normalizes line endings to the given marker (via mime.eol).

stuff.desc: Creates a 'dot-stuffing' filter (doubles the dots at the start of a line, for SMTP) via mime.dot.
